newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ building consents rose in yr to April - SNZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ building consents rose in yr to April - SNZ.

text.p: New Zealand non-residential building consents rose in value by 7.5 percent in the year to April to NZ$2.38 billion, Statistics NZ (SNZ) said on Thursday.

SNZ said on a monthly basis non-residential consents rose after three successive months of falls. Consents worth NZ$193.8 million were issued for non-residential buldings in April, up from NZ$121.7 million in March.
Consents for residential buildings remain stable, as they have been for several months, and rose 4.4 percent to NZ$3.56 billion in the April year.
